note: Sparkasse Bank BiH's standard information sheet for the current account with debit card (V3, in force from 31 March 2026): 5.99 KM for keeping a current/foreign-currency account, in the Federation and in Republika Srpska alike, calculated on the last working day of each month; card and cash charges aren't modelled.
